data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Book > Map search, type the origin and pick the airport, search, open the list of results), but it swaps in trip_type, date_mode and max_price for search_type and flexible_dates and adds a max price step the actions don't show, though the steps are concrete enough to automate.
